name: VC Dimension of Singleton–Cosingleton Classes
proof: Every three-coordinate set is shattered: singletons give its one-element traces, cosingletons its two-element traces, and an index outside the triple supplies the empty and full traces. No four-coordinate set is shattered, since all its traces have sizes zero, one, three or four, never two. For $n\ge4$ this proves VC exactly three.
references: Local definition-driven proof and exact finite replay in sync/verify_singleton_cosingleton.py. The class was already used in the survey's signed intersection-completion argument.
